title: 在既有交易脈動區分最新持有決策與區間成交

latest_holds.summary: Three named paper Personas with available latest hold_signal/no_trade outcomes, generated requested_quantity=1, null broker submission/side/order identities and null fills are omitted from notable events. Persona rows reuse tradeJourneys.reasons.hold_signal, preserve latest decision timestamps and scoped latest/history links, and do not present the generated quantity as an order or fill. Explicit submitted=false holds are also normal; contradictory submission, order identities, side, positive fill, cash shortfall, non-no_trade kind and unavailable outcome evidence remain traceable.

event_and_period_quantities.summary: Event display and full-fill classification use only latestOutcome requested/filled quantities. An explicit available pre-broker rejection may establish zero fills for that intent. Period telemetry never supplies an event quantity, rate or full-fill proof. Partial/overfills use their own 4/10 (40%) and 12/10 (120%) quantities even while period telemetry is 1/1. Available executions lacking per-event fill evidence stay visible with an unconfirmed-event-fill message. Existing period counts, 1/1 and 0/452 ratios, P&L, source-failure/staleness/unknown semantics, rankings and diagnostics remain available. Table headers and ratio basis identify period statistics; rate dates come only from its own window/metric period, otherwise the period is unverified.

historical_navigation.summary: The existing actual TradeJourneysPage and TradeJourneyDetailPage are exercised with API fixtures, not route stubs, in zh-TW/en-US at window width 390px. The Persona history link sends tenant-dev/paper/persona-6507750312870d03a241 to listTradeJourneys, opens original tj_79726064-4cc2-5510-8e11-7f5e59ff89bd, displays its 452-share insufficient_cash pre-broker refusal, and returns to Trading Pulse with current holds still normal. Existing PersonaDetail mobile/desktop origin return regression remains green.

fixture_provenance.original: Existing TRADING_PULSE_HOSTED_WIRE_SAMPLE and existing readableJourneys rejection/producer-evidence fixtures are reused without modifying those fixture files.
fixture_provenance.new: latestHoldOverview reproduces the latest projection shape and 2026-11-22T23:34:51-52Z decision timestamps described by the governed task packet. Its three latest journey IDs are explicitly synthetic test IDs. It preserves the original older telemetry rather than inventing new trades.
fixture_provenance.expectation_changes: Original fixtures omit per-event filled_quantity for available latest executions. Tests now assert those executions remain traceable instead of inferring normal full fills from period 1/1; independently known event full fills are covered separately. Period-only labels and headers are updated in existing assertions.
